$comment: Document vectors for contract/schema/aurora-regions.schema.json, added 2026-09-16 with regions part 2 step 10. EVERY CASE IS DERIVED FROM A RULE IN docs/AURORA_REGIONS_SCHEMA.md OR FROM THE PART 2 SPEC, none from a generator's behaviour: the contract leads and aeon's effects_gen.py plus aurora's codec implement against it. Each FAIL case perturbs a PASS document in exactly ONE forbidden way, and each was proven to make this gate RED before being declared a fail-case (a FAIL case the schema accepts means the closure is vacuous, which is the anti-vacuity rule G3 and G7 already carry). WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE, so a silence is not read as coverage: existence vectors. That `preset` names a real record, that `bg.layoutRef` names a real layout, that `bg.span` equals the referenced layout's height, that rectangles lie inside the act or tile it without gaps, and that the union of referenced layouts fits BG_TILE_CAPACITY are all outside a shape schema; the first is the generator's check, the last is measured per act and is what part 2's E3 measured.

cases.name: minimal region: identity by rectangle plus a preset, no background
cases.why: A region before part 2 binds a preset and nothing else; adding the bg key must not disturb a document that omits it. Regression vector for the addition itself.

cases.name: off-grid region with a background layout and a derived span
cases.why: The shipped night region straddles a section line by design (x 3400 to 4799), which is the case identity-by-rectangle exists for, and part 2 gives it its own layout and span.

cases.name: the @act sentinel on layoutRef
cases.why: Inheriting the act's layout must be expressible with the spelling aurora's resolveDisplayedBg already uses, rather than only by omitting the key.

cases.name: effectsRef on a region row
cases.why: RULING Q8: the key stays RESERVED and unspent because a preset document is not total (three measured reasons). A document carrying it must be refused, or the ruling is decorative.

cases.name: a region with no preset
cases.why: Region.rg_effects is a REQUIRED pointer in the engine, so a region with no identity binding cannot be represented. Sections carry no identity to fall back on since part 1 deleted sec_effects.

cases.name: a per-section binding key
cases.why: Option B of Q8 is refused on its own terms: an off-grid region has no single section to inherit from, so no binding in this document may be expressed per-section.

cases.name: the anchor triple authored on the region
cases.why: v_center_y, v_offset and v_factor_bg are parallax_config fields and Region.rg_parallax already names a config, so the anchor is a region fact through one indirection. A second home for it is the failure the one-source ruling names.

cases.name: a zero-width rectangle
cases.why: A region with no extent is not a region; w and h are at least 1. The generator converts to inclusive bounds, so a zero here would emit a reversed range.

cases.name: an empty regions array
cases.why: An act with no regions has no identity anywhere, since sections carry none. Distinct from an absent key: this is a document that looks authored and binds nothing.

cases.name: an unknown key inside bg
cases.why: The document is closed at every level, not only at the top. A nested open object is how a key nobody agreed to reaches a consumer.
